name: claude-review
description: Review, accept, and reject file changes made by Claude Code using native VS Code diffs.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Claude Review restores and deletes workspace files, so it only runs in trusted workspaces.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No changes to review.
Files changed by Claude Code in this workspace will appear here, grouped by Added, Modified, Deleted, and Renamed.
[Refresh](command:claudeReview.refresh)

Open a folder to start reviewing changes.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)

claudeReview.autoTrack.markdownDescription: Automatically start a review session when a workspace opens, so changes made afterwards (by Claude Code or anything else) are listed for review.

claudeReview.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns for paths that are never tracked. Patterns without `/` match a name at any depth.

claudeReview.snapshot.sensitivePatterns.markdownDescription: Files matching these patterns are never copied into extension storage. Changes to them are still detected, but they cannot be rejected automatically unless they are tracked in Git.

claudeReview.snapshot.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Uncommitted or untracked files larger than this are not copied when a session starts. Changes are still detected, but those files cannot be rejected automatically.

claudeReview.snapshot.maxTotalSizeMB.markdownDescription: Maximum total size copied when a session starts.

claudeReview.filesystemMode.maxFiles.markdownDescription: Outside Git repositories every file must be copied at session start. Workspaces with more files than this are not tracked.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run compile-tests && vscode-test
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:unit
